note: Existing upstream scenarios imported verbatim. Casella Song/aria behavior is separately catalog-derived; this is not an engine replay.

scenarios.excerpt:
gaScenario('battlefield-benediction-empower4')
    ->standardDeck('Battlefield Benediction')
    ->seed('myField', 'Kongming, Fel Eidolon')
    ->seed('theirField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('theirField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('theirField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Battlefield Benediction')
    ->castSpell('Battlefield Benediction', pay: 1, window: 'both')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-0', 'TurnEffects', '["HcR3O8vDps","EMPOWERED","EMPOWER_PLUS_4","vz4kc558yx-ACTION_ACTIVATED"]', 'With 3+ opposing units, the champion is empowered by 4 instead of the base 2')
    ->expectZoneCount('myMemory', 1, 1, 'The Class Bonus discount reduces the 2-reserve cost to 1, so only 1 reserve payment is made')
    ->expectDqEmpty()
    ->register();

gaScenario('aella-zephyrs-hand-first-activation-costs-three-less-then-full-price')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('Aella, Zephyr\'s Hand')
    ->seed('myField', 'Aella, Zephyr\'s Hand')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide', player: 2)
    ->seed('myField', 'Giant Tortoise', player: 2)
    ->action(1, 10001, 'myField-1!CustomInput!Activate:0')->target('theirField-1')
    ->expectZoneCount('theirBanish', 1, 1, 'First activation: the target was suppressed with no reserve payment', step: 2)
    ->action(1, 10001, 'myField-1!CustomInput!Activate:0')->pay(3)->target('theirField-1')
    ->expectZoneCount('theirBanish', 2, 1, 'Second activation: it cost the full (3)')
    ->tested('Aella, Zephyr\'s Hand')
    ->covers(['activated-ability', 'suppress', 'targeting', 'cost-reduction', 'first-time'], '(3): As a Spell, **suppress** another target ally, item, or weapon. This ability costs (3) less to activate the first time you activate it.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('aella-zephyrs-hand-fast-activation')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('Aella, Zephyr\'s Hand')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Aella, Zephyr\'s Hand')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide', player: 2)
    ->endTurn()->pass(1)->pass(1)
    ->attack('myField-1', 'theirField-0', player: 2)
    ->answer(1, 'myHand-7')->pay(3)
    ->expectCardExists('myField', 'Aella, Zephyr\'s Hand', 'Activated during the opponent\'s attack')
    ->tested('Aella, Zephyr\'s Hand')
    ->covers(['keyword', 'fast-activation'], '**Fast Activation**')
    ->register();

gaScenario('stormblade-squire-banishes-memory-and-scavenges-arcane')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')->readyFor('Stormblade Squire')
    ->seed('myField', 'Stormblade Squire')->seed('myHand', 'Strategic Warfare')
    ->deckTop(['Dungeon Guide', 'Dungeon Guide', 'Dungeon Guide', 'Unstable Voltage', 'Dungeon Guide'])
    ->reachTurnThree()->castSpell('Strategic Warfare', pay: 2, window: 'both')->attack('myField-1', 'theirField-0')
    ->answer(1, 'YES')
    ->expectZoneCount('myBanish', 1, 1, 'One memory card was banished')->expectCardExists('myHand', 'Unstable Voltage', 'Scavenge finds the Arcane card')
    ->tested('Stormblade Squire')->covers(['on-attack', 'random', 'scavenge'], 'Banish random memory; scavenge 2+X for arcane.')->register();

gaScenario('harness-lightning-empower-and-self-banish')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')->readyFor('Harness Lightning')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Harness Lightning')->castSpell('Harness Lightning', pay: 1)->answer(1, '0')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-0', 'TurnEffects', '["vz4kc558yx-ACTION_ACTIVATED","bzwj7ztr78","EMPOWERED","EMPOWER_PLUS_4"]', 'Empower four is installed')
    ->expectPower('p1Field-0', 0, 'Empower does not give champion power')
    ->expectCardExists('myBanish', 'Harness Lightning', 'Harness Lightning banishes itself')
    ->expectDqEmpty()->tested('Harness Lightning')->covers(['modal', 'empower', 'banish'], 'Empower four, then banish Harness Lightning.')->register();

gaScenario('harness-lightning-buffs-ally-and-self-banishes')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')->readyFor('Harness Lightning')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide')->seed('myHand', 'Harness Lightning')
    ->castSpell('Harness Lightning', pay: 1)->answer(1, '1')->target('myField-1')
    ->expectPower('p1Field-1', 5, 'Dungeon Guide gets four additional power')
    ->expectCardExists('myBanish', 'Harness Lightning', 'Harness Lightning banishes itself')
    ->expectDqEmpty()->tested('Harness Lightning')->covers(['modal', 'stat-change', 'banish'], 'Target ally gets four power, then banish Harness Lightning.')->register();

gaScenario('stridetech-w-on-enter-with-the-linked-ally-draws-into-memory')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('StrideTech W')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myHand', 'StrideTech W')
    ->play('StrideTech W')->answer(1, 'myField-1')->pay(2)
    ->expectZoneCount('myMemory', 3, 1, 'Two paid cards plus the card drawn into memory')
    ->tested('StrideTech W')
    ->covers(['ally-link', 'on-enter', 'draw-into-memory', 'condition'], '**Ally Link**', '**On Enter:** If you control the linked ally, draw a card into your memory.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('stridetech-w-pays-one-and-sacrifices-itself-to-return-the-linked-ally-to-memory')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('StrideTech W')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myHand', 'StrideTech W')
    ->play('StrideTech W')->answer(1, 'myField-1')->pay(2)
    ->action(1, 10001, 'myField-2!CustomInput!Activate:0')->pay(1)
    ->expectCardExists('myMemory', 'Dungeon Guide', 'The linked ally was returned to its owner\'s memory')
    ->expectZoneCount('myField', 1, 1, 'Only the champion is left on the field')
    ->expectCardExists('myGraveyard', 'StrideTech W', 'StrideTech W was sacrificed')
    ->tested('StrideTech W')
    ->covers(['ally-link', 'sacrifice', 'zone-movement'], '**(1), Sacrifice CARDNAME: **Return the linked ally to its owner\'s memory.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('fairy-whispers-reveals-a-wind-card-and-puts-it-into-hand')
    ->standardDeck('Fairy Whispers')
    ->readyFor('Fairy Whispers')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Fairy Whispers')
    ->deckTop(['Aenean Reclaim', 'Dungeon Guide', 'Dungeon Guide'])
    ->castSpell('Fairy Whispers', pay: 1, window: 'me')
    ->answer(1, 'Top=DCzUre54F9,em6eEh9q8y,em6eEh9q8y;Bottom=')
    ->expectCardExists('myHand', 'Aenean Reclaim', 'The revealed top card is wind element: it went into hand')
    ->tested('Fairy Whispers')
    ->covers(['glimpse', 'look', 'condition'], '**Glimpse 3**. *(To **glimpse**, look at that many cards from the top of your deck. Put those cards back on the top or on the bottom of your deck in any order.)*', 'Reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is wind element, put it into your hand.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('fairy-whispers-leaves-a-non-wind-top-card-on-the-deck')
    ->standardDeck('Fairy Whispers')
    ->readyFor('Fairy Whispers')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Fairy Whispers')
    ->deckTop(['Dungeon Guide', 'Aenean Reclaim', 'Dungeon Guide'])
    ->castSpell('Fairy Whispers', pay: 1, window: 'me')
    ->answer(1, 'Top=em6eEh9q8y,DCzUre54F9,em6eEh9q8y;Bottom=')
    ->expectZoneCount('myHand', 6, 1, 'Nothing was added to the hand (8 - 1 cast - 1 paid)')
    ->tested('Fairy Whispers')
    ->covers(['condition'], 'Reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is wind element, put it into your hand.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('windmill-engineer-imbued-on-enter-draws-a-card-into-memory')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Windmill Engineer')
    ->readyFor('Windmill Engineer')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Windrider Mage')->seed('myHand', 'Windrider Mage')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Windmill Engineer')
    ->play('Windmill Engineer')->answer(1, 'YES')->answer(1, 'myHand-7')->answer(1, 'myHand-7')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-1', 'TurnEffects', '["IMBUED","ENTERED_THIS_TURN"]', 'Two wind cards were reserved: imbued')
    ->expectZoneCount('myMemory', 3, 1, 'Two reserved cards plus the card drawn into memory')
    ->tested('Windmill Engineer')
    ->covers(['imbue', 'on-enter', 'draw-discard', 'condition'], '**Imbue 2**', '**On Enter:** If CARDNAME is **imbued**, draw a card into your memory.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('windmill-engineer-not-imbued-on-enter-draws-nothing')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Windmill Engineer')
    ->readyFor('Windmill Engineer')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Windmill Engineer')
    ->play('Windmill Engineer')->answer(1, 'NO')->pay(2)
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-1', 'TurnEffects', '["ENTERED_THIS_TURN"]', 'Not imbued')
    ->expectZoneCount('myMemory', 2, 1, 'Only the two paid cards')
    ->tested('Windmill Engineer')
    ->covers(['imbue', 'on-enter', 'condition'], 'If CARDNAME is **imbued**')
    ->register();
